- Tooltips improve

notes.title: Version 1.84
notes.notes:
- Quick save is added (F5 hotkey)
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.83
notes.notes:
- Windowed mode option is added (In the settings menu or with the f hotkey)
- Improvement of hotkeys in the battle

notes.title: Version 1.81
notes.notes:
- 470 legendary artifacts added
- New events added

notes.title: Version 1.77
notes.notes:
- Added potions that increase character stats forever
- Added speed setting for cards animation in events
- Sliders to adjust the volume of sound and music for the PC version of the game
- Select an active skill in battle using the number keys for the PC version of the game
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.75
notes.notes:
With 10% chance characters you defeated in the battle will be placed into your prison, provided that you have free places in a suitable prison

After serving time in prison, the character may want to join you or reveal their secrets

There is a chance that the character will escape from prison. It depends on the level of the character, the level of the prison and the warden

notes.title: Version 1.67
notes.notes:
- Added preview of the active ability effect when selecting a target
- Added the capability to switch to your squad in the event interface
- Statuses "Madness" and "Lack of will" effect improved
- Now the "Dark fate" status can be removed by the effects of purification and dissipation

notes.title: Version 1.66
notes.notes:
- The character can now leave the player if he has a critically low level of happiness
- Added in-game wiki

The in-game wiki currently refers to the collection of all hints in one place, grouped by category. When you open the menu from the game in the upper left corner there is an icon with a question that will open this wiki

notes.title: Version 1.62
notes.notes:
- The difficulty of the game now affects a number of aspects
- Manual difficulty configure added
- Added a built infirmary at the beginning of the game in strategic mode
- Enemy characters can now be generated with a scroll or potion

notes.title: Version 1.57
notes.notes:
- Added chiefs
- Greatly increased the deposits of resources on hexagons
- Minor interface improvements
